name: Geppo
description: One of the Six Powers (Rokushiki): one hop on the air, then sustained sky-walking, then fighting in the air.

stages.name: One hop on the air
stages.description: Geppo: one hop on the air.
stages.text: You managed Geppo for the first time: one hop on the air.

stages.name: Sustained sky-walking
stages.text: Geppo came to you without thinking now: sustained sky-walking.

stages.name: Fighting in the air
stages.description: Geppo mastered: fighting in the air.
stages.text: You had mastered Geppo: fighting in the air.
